title: A NOVEL ETHER FORMATION REACTION VIA CHLOROACETYLHYDRAZONES
abstract: Abstract                Chloroacetylhydrazones were allowed to react with sodium alkoxide in alcohol to give acetic ester of the alcohol and unsymmetrical ethers derived from the alkoxide and the alkylidene moiety of the hydrazones. Secondary and tertiary alkoxides failed to afford any amount of ethers. High yields of ethers were realized especially in the reaction of cyclohexanone chloroacetylhydrazone.
